patch_description: The previous edit failed because my SEARCH text was missing a line (`best, best_val = cur.copy(), cur_val`) that exists in the actual file. I split the change into two targeted edits with exact SEARCH text. Edit 1 replaces the chunked `_min_area` with a fully vectorized objective (all 165 triplets at once via a precomputed index array), a vectorized barycentric clip (the recommended hot-path fix), and helper samplers. Edit 2 replaces the weak simulated-annealing core (which only moved 8 of 11 points and got stuck at score 0.18) with a deterministic multi-start greedy hill-climbing scheme with decaying step sizes that perturbs the vertices of the near-worst triangles, moving any of the 11 points, plus a final coordinate-descent polish. Multi-start with random barycentric restarts is the key improvement for escaping the poor local optimum.
